caption:
Koko teaches four yoga classes a day. Her students leave feeling loose, but her own shoulders and wrists feel tighter.

Demonstrating the same poses every class keeps the same muscles working over and over. Demoing less and guiding with words and cues can give your body a break.

Hybi's recovery: water and five minutes' rest between classes, gentle wrist circles, and demo once or twice before cueing. Massage can help tight spots feel easier.

Hand tingling that keeps coming back is worth an assessment first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD remedial massage therapists can help. Book online via the link in bio
